content.statement: When a statute is partly inconsistent with Part III, the inconsistent portion may be severed so that the valid remainder continues to operate if it can stand independently and the legislature would have enacted the remainder without the invalid part.
content.development: Operates with Article 13's voidness to the extent of inconsistency.
content.application: Argue severability when only discrete provisions of a statute are unconstitutional.
exceptions: Inseverable schemes where the invalid part is the essence of the law
